scenario: a routine everyday need involving taxi & ride services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Routine Everyday Need Involving Taxi and Ride Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: taxi & ride services — a routine everyday need involving taxi & ride services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a routine everyday need involving taxi & ride services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Daniel, the taxi driver, to drive more slowly.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh Daniel, tài xế taxi, lái chậm lại một chút.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Daniel, can you drive more slowly, please?
turns.vietnamese: Daniel này, anh lái chậm lại một chút được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.english: Yes, I will slow down now.
turns.vietnamese: Được ạ, tôi chạy chậm lại ngay đây.
